chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The ignorant among you get too much while the learned are just put off.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the reward of the ignorant and the learned according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this concise aphorism from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the societal paradox where the ignorant (*jahil*) often gain worldly abundance or status, while the learned (*alim*) face delay (*musawwif*) in receiving their due recognition or reward. This reflects the Shia understanding of the 'delay' not merely as neglect, but as a divine test and a gradual accumulation of merit, contrasting the immediate gratification of the masses with the enduring, often delayed, justice for the knowledgeable.
